scope: Proposition 25.6 (Geometric preparation) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 146. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the prepared data satisfying (25.1), there are a closed connected exterior Ω ⊂ M with one end and nonempty compact smooth boundary B, two negative numbers cb, cw, and a decomposition of B into black and white components with the following properties. With the normal ν into Ω and PB = trB K, (25.13) H + PB = cb on black components, H − PB = cw on white components. The components come from closed total-region families Dc and Wc at right-continuity thresholds cb and cw, respectively. The white family is formed with the black region fixed, and is allowed to be empty. Every face has a disjoint smooth collar in Ω, with parameter s ≥ 0, | ds| > 0, and the corresponding expansion toward increasing s is at least cb or cw. There are a0 > 0, a compactly supported smooth function C, and a positive smooth weight ρ, equal to a positive constant times r−4−δ1 on the end, such that |C| ≤ a0 and, on smaller collars, (25.14) C = a0 − κBs on black collars, C = −a0 + κBs on white collars, κB > 0. Set (25.15) b− = cb − a0 < 0 < −cw + a0 = b+. Every real-valued function h taking values in [b−, b+] on supp K∩Ω satisfies the following inequality on Ω: (25.16) |(h + C)τ| + | dC|g + ρ ≤ µ − |J|g, τ = trg K. There is a smooth compactly supported extension b on Ω of the boundary values b− on black faces and b+ on white faces, constant on smaller collars. Finally, every smooth enclosing cut of B in Ω has g-volume at least A∗.
